From 3adbbd2295ad138ab95404d0ffc6bfc1b8f9f1e4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2020 15:42:09 +1000
Subject: [PATCH] hwrng: cctrng - Add dependency on HAS_IOMEM

The cctrng doesn't compile without HAS_IOMEM so we should depend
on it.

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: a583ed310bb6 ("hwrng: cctrng - introduce Arm CryptoCell driver")
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>
Acked-by: Hadar Gat <hadar.gat@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

diff --git a/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig b/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
index 848f26f78dc1..0c99735df694 100644
--- a/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig
@@ -476,6 +476,7 @@ config HW_RANDOM_KEYSTONE
 
 config HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG
 	tristate "Arm CryptoCell True Random Number Generator support"
+	depends on HAS_IOMEM
 	default HW_RANDOM
 	help
 	  This driver provides support for the True Random Number
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/char/hw_random/Kconfig`**
   - Added a dependency for the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` configuration option on `HAS_IOMEM`. This means that the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver will only compile if `HAS_IOMEM` is enabled.

### Relationships

The modification establishes a relationship between the `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver and the `HAS_IOMEM` configuration. By adding this dependency, it ensures that the driver will not be compiled unless the necessary memory I/O support is available, thus preventing compilation errors related to missing dependencies. This change addresses a specific issue reported by the kbuild test robot, indicating that the driver was failing to compile without the `HAS_IOMEM` option.

hwrng: cctrng - Add dependency on HAS_IOMEM

The cctrng doesn't compile without HAS_IOMEM so we should depend
on it.

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: a583ed310bb6 ("hwrng: cctrng - introduce Arm CryptoCell driver")

Acked-by: Hadar Gat <hadar.gat@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Herbert Xu <herbert@gondor.apana.org.au>

Here is the root cause:
The `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver was attempting to compile without the necessary memory I/O support provided by `HAS_IOMEM`, leading to compilation failures. This indicates that the driver relies on memory-mapped I/O operations that are not available unless `HAS_IOMEM` is enabled.

Here is the patch:
 config HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG
 	tristate "Arm CryptoCell True Random Number Generator support"
+	depends on HAS_IOMEM
 	default HW_RANDOM
 	help

The `HW_RANDOM_CCTRNG` driver was defined without a dependency on `HAS_IOMEM`, which is essential for memory-mapped I/O operations. This omission caused compilation failures when the driver was built without the necessary memory I/O support.
